description: Use this when the user wants a rent ledger, tenant ledger, rent ledger template filled in, or proof of rent payments for a tenant: 'make a ledger of my tenant payments this year', 'tenant paid 800 of 1200 rent, what is the balance', amount due as of a date. Takes lease terms (rent, start, due day, late fee rule with grace period) and payments typed or from an attached CSV/Excel file; charges rent monthly with prorated first/last months, applies payments oldest first, adds late fees (flat, percent, daily with cap), carries overpayments forward as credit, and returns a running balance plus PDF statement, Excel and CSV downloads. Does not check state late-fee limits, give legal advice, collect rent, or make rent receipts for proof of address.

as_of_date.description: Statement date: charges and payments up to and including this day, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-03. Use the date the user names, otherwise today's date from the conversation (the user's local date).

landlord_name.description: Landlord or property manager name for the statement header, e.g. Oak Street Rentals LLC.

late_fee.description: Late fee rule from the lease, e.g. {"type": "flat", "amount": 75, "grace_days": 5}. Omit for no late fees.

amount.description: Flat late fee in USD for type flat or flat_plus_daily, e.g. 75.

daily_amount.description: Daily late fee in USD for type daily or flat_plus_daily, e.g. 10.

grace_days.description: Days after the due date that rent is still on time, e.g. 5: due the 1st, paid by the 6th is on time, fee on the 7th. If the lease says 'late after the 5th', use 4. Default 0.

max_percent_of_rent.description: Optional cap as a percent of that month's rent, e.g. 10. With max_total, the lower cap applies.

max_total.description: Optional cap on all late fees for one month's rent, in USD, e.g. 150.

percent.description: Percent for type percent, e.g. 5 for 5%.

percent_of.description: For type percent: the month's rent charge (default) or only the unpaid part of it.

type.description: Late fee rule from the lease: none, flat (e.g. $75 once per month), percent (e.g. 5% of the month's rent), daily (e.g. $10 per day late), flat_plus_daily (e.g. $50 then $10 per day).

lease_end.description: Move-out date (last day charged), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-08-10. Omit for an ongoing tenancy.

lease_start.description: Lease start or move-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-01-17. A mid-month start is prorated when rent is due on the 1st.

monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent in USD from the lease, e.g. 1450.

other_charges.description: Charges other than rent (utilities, pet rent, repair, returned check fee) and credits (concessions). Do not include the security deposit unless the user asks.

amount.description: Amount in USD; positive = charge (e.g. 45.20), negative = credit to the tenant (e.g. -100).

date.description: Date of the charge or credit, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-03-05.

description.description: What it is, e.g. Water bill, Pet rent, Returned check fee, Rent concession.

payment_order.description: How payments are applied: oldest_first (default, oldest unpaid charge first, including late fees) or rent_first (rent and other charges before late fees).

payments.description: Payments received from the tenant, e.g. [{"date": "2026-02-03", "amount": 1450}]. Payments before a due date become a credit.

amount.description: Amount received in USD, e.g. 800. A returned or bounced payment is negative, e.g. -1450 with memo 'Returned check 1042'.

date.description: Date the payment was received, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-02-03.

memo.description: Optional short note, e.g. Check 1042, Zelle, Cash. No bank account numbers.

payments_file.description: Optional CSV or Excel (.xlsx) list of payments with a date column and an amount column, e.g. payments-2026.csv.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

property.description: Property or unit, e.g. 412 Oak St, Unit 2B, Austin, TX.

proration_method.description: How a partial first or last month is prorated: actual_days (default, rent / days in month), thirty_day (rent / 30), annual_365 (rent x 12 / 365).

proration_rounding.description: round_total (default, round only the final amount to the cent) or daily_rate_first (round the daily rate to the cent before multiplying).

rent_changes.description: Rent increases or decreases during the period, e.g. [{"effective_date": "2026-07-01", "monthly_rent": 1525}].

effective_date.description: First rent due date at the new amount, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-07-01.

monthly_rent.description: New monthly rent in USD, e.g. 1525.

rent_due_day.description: Day of the month rent is due, 1-28, e.g. 1 (default).

tenant_name.description: Tenant name shown on the statement, e.g. Maria Lopez. Do not include a Social Security number.

name: generate_rent_ledger
title: Generate rent ledger
